body: REQUIRED for the sweep (orchestrator, row 13 check on 49fbdfa, quiet machine): whole `vitest run` = 13 failures in 8 files, all under src/main/git and src/main/github (untouched by this epic since fd857e3): 10 x 'Test timed out in 15000ms' (pullRequestsCheckout x3, branches, branchesSafety, commitLinesProperty, conflicts, stash x2, conflictsOpen PATHEXT) and 3 pre-existing symlink EPERM tests (conflictsOpen x2, handlersWorkingDiff).
